rules: No corporate contributions to candidates, parties, PACs or ballot committees; the company sponsors no PAC
Employees' personal political activity on own time, never reimbursed
Lobbying only through firms cleared under the third-party procedure; registrant filings reviewed quarterly

Hospitality to officials pre-cleared by the General Counsel and logged within five business days; federal executive employees limited to USD 20 per occasion and USD 50 per year (5 CFR 2635.204), congressional staff per chamber gift rules (USD 50), state and local officials USD 75 per occasion
Every interaction with officials on a pending company matter logged
detail.title: Political Activity, Lobbying and Government Interaction Policy
